title: My 3D Pipeline Progression
author: Fuzzzy420
selftext:
Hey Team,

im developing a procedural generated Dungeon, for that i created a concept diorama .  
Here is the progress of about 3 Weeks (on and off). There are 1000 more Screenshots but who cares.  
The whole design is now part of the procedural generator but out of tokens for the week.  
This Screenshots show playable scenes, not just ai art (besides the concept art which is essential for iteration).

All Assets created with Blender MCP  
All AI Usage done with OpenAI Modells  
Astra is just the best, i tried all OpenAI Modells and Astra was straight up the best for Blender. But it needs endless iterations, there is no shortcut.  
The Game and the Generator are written in c++ using SDL3

  
Im close but not done yet, i would say 85% ?  
What do you think?
